listing.name: THREAT DETECTED
listing.aiSummary: Adds a challenging fleet encounter featuring Fabricators that can be beaten.

description: Introduces a difficult enemy fleet centered around Fabricators. The final version balances the encounter by limiting Fabricator count and production capacity to make it beatable.
